outcomes.question: What was the average retail maize price in Nigeria in 2024, and in which unit is it reported?

SELECT f.price_avg, f.common_unit_price_avg, f.market_count, f.year, f.month, f.country_name, f.price_source, d0.product_name, d1.organisation_name FROM (SELECT price_avg, common_unit_price_avg, market_count, year, month, country_name, price_source, product_key, source_key FROM `opentrace-prod-5ga4.mart_dev.agg_prices_country_month` WHERE country_name = 'Nigeria' AND year BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025 AND product_key IN (SELECT product_key FROM `opentrace-prod-5ga4.mart_dev.dim_product` WHERE product_name = 'Maize') AND price_type = 'Retail' AND year = 2024 ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 50) AS f LEFT JOIN `opentrace-prod-5ga4.mart_dev.dim_product` AS d0 ON d0.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN `opentrace-prod-5ga4.mart_dev.dim_source` AS d1 ON d1.source_key = f.source_key ORDER BY f.month DESC
